Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent made a fundamental error in comparing the masses of subatomic particles. It incorrectly stated that $10^{-31}$ is a larger power-of-ten than $10^{-27}$ (claiming $31 > 27$ implies a larger value in this context) and concluded that $9.11 \times 10^{-31}$ kg (electron) is greater than $1.67 \times 10^{-27}$ kg (proton). In reality, a larger negative exponent means a smaller number; therefore, the electron is significantly lighter than the proton. This logic flaw led to the wrong conclusion that losing a proton results in the least mass loss, whereas losing an electron is the correct answer.
